verdict.rationale: Fly.io describes itself as a global public cloud. Whether a PaaS can be self-hosted is a fair question for buyers comparing cloud platforms, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Fly.io offering a self-hostable or on-prem version of its platform. Deploying your own apps onto Fly's infrastructure with `fly launch` is not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
